content:
# Adding ACK-Managed Logs S3 Bucket + IRSA + Flux Kustomization

Here's the idiomatic implementation for knr-ops:

## File Structure

```
infra/
├── s3/
│   └── logs/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       ├── bucket.yaml
│       └── public-access-block.yaml
├── iam/
│   └── logs-irsa/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       ├── role.yaml
│       └── policy.yaml
├── overlays/
│   ├── dev/
│   │   ├── kustomization.yaml
│   │   ├── s3-logs-patch.yaml
│   │   └── iam-logs-patch.yaml
│   └── prod/
│       ├── kustomization.yaml
│       ├── s3-logs-patch.yaml
│       └── iam-logs-patch.yaml
└── flux/
    └── logs-kustomization.yaml
```

---

## 1. Base S3 Bucket Manifest

**`infra/s3/logs/bucket.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: infra-aws
  labels:
    app: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucket: "myapp-logs-dev"  # Patched per environment
    region: us-east-1
    versioning:
      - enabled: true
    serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
      - rule:
          - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              - sseAlgorithm: AES256
    tags:
      ManagedBy: flux
      Component: logging
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider  # References ACK provider config
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: myapp-logs-bucket
    namespace: infra-aws
```

**`infra/s3/logs/public-access-block.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-pab
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucketRef:
      name: myapp-logs
    blockPublicAcls: true
    blockPublicPolicy: true
    ignorePublicAcls: true
    restrictPublicBuckets: true
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider
```

**`infra/s3/logs/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: s3-logs
namespace: infra-aws

resources:
  - bucket.yaml
  - public-access-block.yaml
```

---

## 2. IRSA Role & Policy

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/role.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  namespace: infra-aws
  labels:
    app: myapp-logs
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "OIDC_PROVIDER_ARN"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "OIDC_ISSUER:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-sa"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    tags:
      ManagedBy: flux
      Component: logging
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: myapp-logs-irsa-role-arn
    namespace: infra-aws
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/policy.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-bucket-access
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    roleRef:
      name: myapp-logs-irsa
    policy: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:GetObject",
              "s3:PutObject",
              "s3:DeleteObject"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*/*"
          },
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Action": [
              "s3:ListBucket",
              "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
            ],
            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*"
          }
        ]
      }
  providerConfigRef:
    name: aws-provider
```

**`infra/iam/logs-irsa/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: iam-logs-irsa
namespace: infra-aws

resources:
  - role.yaml
  - policy.yaml
```

---

## 3. Environment Overlays

**`overlays/dev/s3-logs-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucket: myapp-logs-dev
    tags:
      Environment: dev
```

**`overlays/dev/iam-logs-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::DEV_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-sa"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

**`overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: knr-ops-dev
namespace: flux-system

bases:
  - ../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../infra/iam/logs-irsa

patchesStrategicMerge:
  - s3-logs-patch.yaml
  - iam-logs-patch.yaml

commonLabels:
  environment: dev
```

**`overlays/prod/s3-logs-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    bucket: myapp-logs-prod
    tags:
      Environment: prod
```

**`overlays/prod/iam-logs-patch.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa
  namespace: infra-aws
spec:
  forProvider:
    assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
      {
        "Version": "2012-10-17",
        "Statement": [
          {
            "Effect": "Allow",
            "Principal": {
              "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::PROD_ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID"
            },
            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
            "Condition": {
              "StringEquals": {
                "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD_OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-sa"
              }
            }
          }
        ]
      }
```

**`overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: knr-ops-prod
namespace: flux-system

bases:
  - ../../infra/s3/logs
  - ../../infra/iam/logs-irsa

patchesStrategicMerge:
  - s3-logs-patch.yaml
  - iam-logs-patch.yaml

commonLabels:
  environment: prod
```

---

## 4. Flux Kustomization

**`flux/logs-kustomization.yaml`**
```yaml
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: knr-ops
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m
  url: https://github.com/your-org/knr-ops.git
  ref:
    branch: main
  # Add SOPS decryption if needed:
  # postBuild:
  #   substitute: {}
  #   substituteFrom:
  #     - kind: ConfigMap
  #       name: cluster-vars

---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  retryInterval: 1m
  timeout: 5m
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  path: ./overlays/dev  # or prod based on cluster
  prune: true
  wait: true
  postBuild:
    substitute:
      ACCOUNT_ID: "123456789"
      OIDC_ID: "EXAMPLEID"
      OIDC_ISSUER: "oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLEID"
    # Or use SOPS:
    # substituteFrom:
    #   - kind: Secret
    #     name: aws-oidc-vars
  healthChecks:
    - apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
      kind: Bucket
      name: myapp-logs
      namespace: infra-aws
```

---

## 5. Application ServiceAccount (for reference)

In your application namespace, create:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-sa
  namespace: myapp
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-irsa
```

---

## Integration Checklist

- [ ] Update `overlays/{dev,prod}/kustomization.yaml` to include the new bases if not using the Flux Kustomization above
- [ ] Substitute `DEV_ACCOUNT_ID`, `PROD_ACCOUNT_ID`, `DEV_OIDC_ID`, `PROD_OIDC_ID`, `OIDC_ISSUER` with cluster-specific values
- [ ] Verify ACK provider config (`aws-provider`) exists in `infra-aws` namespace
- [ ] If using SOPS for OIDC secrets, encrypt the patches: `sops -e overlays/dev/iam-logs-patch.yaml > overlays/dev/iam-logs-patch.enc.yaml`
- [ ] Reference encrypted files in `kustomization.yaml` using `sopsFiles` directive
- [ ] Apply: `flux reconcile ks logs-bucket --with-source`
- [ ] Verify: `kubectl get bucket,role -n infra-aws`

This implementation follows knr-ops idioms: base + overlay separation, environment isolation, ACK CRDs, and Flux-native reconciliation.
